item.description: Miami, FL - November 29, 2025 - A tech titan is taking the wheel at one of Florida’s most beloved wildlife attractions — Larry Ellison has purchased Lion Country Safari, the iconic 254-acre drive-through adventure park near West Palm Beach that has delighted visitors for nearly six decades. item.title: Oliver Heldens at LIV - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - November 29, 2025 - Oliver Heldens took over LIV with a vibrant, groove-packed set that had the crowd dancing from the moment he hit the decks. Blending his signature future-house sound with infectious basslines and standout drops, he turned the club into a high-energy celebration all night long.

item.title: Mayami Saturdays - World Red Eye

The venue brought out its high-energy mix of music, performances, and late-night celebration, keeping the crowd going well into the night.

item.title: WRE News: 65% of Miami Residents Are Happy in The City: Are You? WRE Wants To Know - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - November 23, 2025 - Miami’s mood check is in — and most residents say they’re feeling good about life in the Magic City.
